Still, a housing shortage actually works in my favor, and p4's cash is tight at $155 anyway. A hotel on St Charles alone would bring in 750 in rent.

Both hotels net me 125 each in rent gains at a combined cost of $200, but releasing 8 houses back to the bank is risky even though p4 likely can't afford a green or Boardwalk house right now. Given p4's threatening rents on Boardwalk and Park Place, I think I'd rather hold onto my cash than unmortgage Illinois or risk overextending — better to stay cautious and end my turn here.
